cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Who gets the head seat, Grandma or the birthday child? Choose which tradition we're using before I lay the places.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put two chairs there. Would that do?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For sitting, yes. Now choose which tradition decides whom I serve first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Serve them together. Except there's only one birthday pudding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then decide before I bring it in: elders first or birthdays first? I'll divide the pudding after the wish. Until you've chosen, nobody at those two chairs gets to call me over.

reason: Make A grant the seating compromise but control serving until B selects a tradition; use the single pudding and wish as the concrete unresolved priority.
